about.title: About Us
about.lead: An engineering firm built for industrial performance
about.description: NORWEST DYNAMIC SYSTEMS is an industrial automation and robotics integration firm based in Tijuana, B.C. — serving manufacturers across Mexico and the U.S. border region. We design, build, program, and commission automated systems that deliver measurable results: higher throughput, lower scrap, and reduced labor dependency. From concept to commissioning, we work as an embedded technical partner — not just a vendor.
about.missionText: To design, integrate, and execute high-performance engineering, automation, and industrial control solutions, ensuring quality, reliability, and measurable results for our clients, while driving technological growth in the Tijuana–San Diego region.
about.visionText: To be the leading engineering and automation firm in the binational region, recognized for its technical excellence, operational discipline, and ability to transform industrial processes into world-class solutions.
about.valuesLead: The principles that define how we work and who we are.

about.v7Desc: We act as owners of value, not just executors of work.
